concept.literalSynthesis: A Jester Star Musket paired with a fallen star as ammunition: the musket launches a bright, falling star, and a confirmed impact releases a smaller seeking star.
concept.coreMechanic: Primary use fires one cursor-aimed, gravity-arcing ranged shot and consumes one selected fallen-star round through native ammo handling. On an actual NPC hit, the shot creates one separate, weaker star that slowly homes toward a nearby enemy. The source musket dealt 31 ranged damage on a 32-tick interval; the generated shot keeps that base damage and interval, but trades the source projectile's multi-hit piercing for a single hit because the hit now creates a damaging child. Fallen Star is documented as cheap ammunition with no standalone weapon damage, so its -1 damage sentinel is not treated as damage. One round is still consumed for each primary shot; no extra ammo is consumed by the child. The child adds a modest follow-up rather than making the plentiful input ammunition produce an unbounded chain.
concept.parentAContribution: The Jester Star Musket supplies the musket identity, ranged damage class, 31 base damage, 5.25 knockback, 32-tick use tempo, cursor-shot control and existing fallen-star ammo requirement. Its observed projectile had a 9-pixel-per-tick launch speed and 28-pixel forward offset; those become explicit authored launch values. The new gravity arc and on-hit child are authored mechanics, not claims about the source weapon.
concept.parentBContribution: The Fallen Star supplies the exact fallen_star ammo category and its familiar star identity. Its low value and large stack size support using it as a round; its -1 damage is an ammo sentinel, not attack damage. The separate seeking child is a new mechanic inspired by the star identity.
concept.playerExperience: Aim and fire at the normal musket cadence. Each shot costs one fallen star; a direct hit may produce one weaker homing follow-up. The follow-up is bounded to one child per hit and does not guarantee another hit.

plannedPlayerActions.intent: Aim at a target and fire one gravity-arcing musket star, consuming one fallen-star round; a confirmed hit releases one weaker, slowly homing star.

realization.description: Fire with primary use to launch a cursor-aimed star at the musket's normal 32-tick interval. Each shot consumes one fallen star as ammunition. The main star follows a downward gravity arc and deals 31 ranged damage with one-hit penetration. When it actually hits an NPC, it creates one separate 12-damage star that slowly homes within 18 blocks for up to 1.25 seconds. Tile impacts or missed shots do not create a child.
realization.playerExperience: The star round is spent on the primary shot. The follow-up adds a chance to pressure a nearby second target, while its short life, low speed and modest damage keep the ammunition's follow-through bounded.
